title: Print statements
syllabusDesc: Send output to the console and combine strings and values.
details: Print literals or variables; print("Hi", name) inserts a space for you.
Use f"" strings to embed expressions inline, e.g., f"2 + 2 = {2 + 2}".
Multiple arguments become space-separated in the output.
desc: Use print() to show strings, numbers, and variables. Great for quick checks.
solution:
print("Hello, world!")
name = "Ada"
print("Hi", name)
print(f"2 + 2 = {2 + 2}")
